## Fixes

- **Faster hovering on big maps.** Moving the mouse over the map no longer rebuilds every tile:
  - Only the tiles whose highlight changes are updated.
  - Moving within one cell does nothing.
  - Finding the tile under the pointer checks only the tiles nearby instead of the whole map.
  - The Tiles and Layers panels no longer redraw as you hover.
- **Paint and paste previews** are added on top of the map instead of rebuilding it for every cell the preview moves to.
